resolutions.researcher_notes: Possible other name for P2380, Ring of the Moscow Region Gas Pipeline. A discovery search found a pipeline called "Yakhroma-Noginsk Gas Pipeline" and judged it to be part of this row or another name for it. That is a judgment, and there is a chance it is a different pipeline, so check before accepting. Accepting adds the name to the other English names cell and changes nothing else. What the search found: Matched to existing P2380 (Ring of the Moscow Region, KGMO-1, 365 km, 800 mm, operating). Yakhroma-Noginsk (82 km, built 1985; Gazprom Transgaz Moskva Moskovskoe LPUMG page, Wayback copy) is described there as ensuring reliability and safe operation of KGMO. neftegazpro.ru (2023-11) reports the 2024 start of reconstruction of the ring gas pipeline KGMO-1 'on the section KS Noginsk - KS Yakhroma' (design throughput 28.82 bcm/y, customer Gazprom Transgaz Moskva), i.e. the line is a named sector of KGMO-1, not a separate pipeline. Web-search snippets (unverified fetch) gave 81.9 km / DN1020 for the section and a 12.4 km DN1220 bypass in the KGMO-I reconstruction; not cited. Action for Update: consider whether P2380's 365 km / 800 mm reflects this sector; add 'Yakhroma-Noginsk' to P2380 OtherEnglishNames or leave as a segment note. No new row. [QC] independent=yes claimed on 0 surviving ref(s) from 0 publisher(s) -> no.
